name: Goshogawara Yuuki
source:
Liked food: Will eat anything as long as it's edible
Dislikes food: Plain, tasteless food

A fifth year at Harekita Academy, she’s a childhood friend of [url=/c34578]Souta[/url], as well as his classmate, and a fellow part timer at a cafe called Naturale. Yuuki is open to talking about anything in the same way a guy friend would be, but her relentless sex talk isn’t to be taken lightly. When she was young, Yuuki ____________, but Souta ____________, so she keeps it a secret. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1089]MangaGamer[/url]]
